NBA Hits Clippers With Historic Penalties
videos.description: The NBA fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and stripped the franchise of five first-round draft picks after an independent investigation found the team circumvented salary-cap rules by facilitating off-court income opportunities for Kawhi Leonard. Bloomberg News Senior Sports Reporter Randall Williams joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains that owner Steve Ballmer was also suspended for a year, while Leonard was fined $700,000 in one of the league’s most severe disciplinary actions. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Rep. Kiley Challenges Party Control in Congress
videos.description: Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Independent California Rep. Kevin Kiley is calling for House rules to guarantee committee assignments for lawmakers who don't belong to either major party, after his own assignments were temporarily vacated when he left the Republican Conference. Kiley also criticizes mid-decade gerrymandering and said he supports mail voting while arguing that nationwide election policy should be set by Congress rather than executive order. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Canada Hits Back With New US Tariffs
videos.description: Canada is set to impose new retaliatory tariffs of as much as 50% on US goods starting Sept. 8, targeting $27.6 billion of imports including steel, aluminum, pulp and paper, appliances and agricultural equipment. Bloomberg News Ottawa Bureau Chief Brian Platt tells Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend that the broader economic impact may be limited, but businesses tied to integrated supply chains, tourism and cross-border commerce could face sharper consequences as the cycle of retaliation continues. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
